profile_text.body:
Raptor Technologies describes itself as a provider of integrated school safety software for K-12. According to its site, the platform lets schools screen visitors, track volunteers, report on drills, respond to emergencies, and reunite families, with the company framing these tools as a unified system that connects workflows and makes reporting consistent. The site also describes campus intelligence tools that give schools real-time visibility into who is on campus and why, centralized data intended to support early intervention on student wellbeing, training resources, and compliance management. A product named Raptor Badge Alert is described as letting staff activate alerts from a wearable badge as part of an emergency management platform. The company says its solutions are built for schools, childcare programs, and youth centers.

The site material includes a mention of Lauren Smith, identified as Volunteer Mentor Program Coordinator at Champaign Community Unit School District, in connection with a session on managing volunteer access.

The company is tracked as an Education and Research AI product, with a note that it was found in research for The AI Ready School and that its AI features are not independently verified. Its stated use is visitor management and emergency tools for staff, and pricing is quote only, with no published pricing.
